'''Buckethead''' was a derogatory nickname for [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and [[TIE pilot]]s, referring to their bucket-shaped helmets.
